pages.text: $(thing)City Ages$() generate roads, towers, apartment blocks, transit structures, bridges, and dense built space. They are among the heaviest terrain definitions in the system and naturally carry a higher instability burden than a standard world.

$(thing)Biosphere Ages$() are void worlds filled with linked domes. Each sphere can carry a real biome, including modded biomes, so native mobs and atmosphere can appear inside a dome if that biome supports them.
Both terrain types are intentionally rare in random Ages. If they appear without being authored, expect the Age to be stranger, riskier, and harder to classify at a glance.
